logic.allocation: Weights specify fractions of initial 2000 USDT capital, not target weights later. Sum actual already-size-costed component NAVs on exactly identical timestamps; no second scaling, averaging Sharpe or new component backtests.
logic.rebalance: No transfers or rebalancing; component absolute NAVs already reflect their specified initial capital and all actual size-dependent costs.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve underlying units/cash
